description:
Welcome to Nuvibody, a leading provider of cutting-edge red light therapy devices. Our unwavering commitment is to enhance people's overall well-being and skin health by offering safe and highly effective treatment solutions.

We offer a range of red light therapy devices. They stimulate collagen production, reduce inflammation, and rejuvenate the skin, earning the trust of professionals across diverse fields, including dermatologists and fitness experts.

What truly distinguishes Nuvibody is the outstanding quality and affordability of our products. We provide top-tier red light therapy devices at competitive prices, ensuring accessibility for all without compromising on effectiveness or safety.

Payment Terms: Join our affiliate program and reap the benefits of a generous 20% commission rate. Earn substantial commissions on high-ticket products when your referrals make purchases using your unique affiliate link or coupon code.

Future Prediction: Notably, Harvard professor Michael Hamblin predicts that within the next decade, every household will own a red light therapy panel due to its profound health benefits.

Benefit from the red light therapy revolution. Help others unlock the health advantages of Nuvibody while boosting your income. It's a mutually beneficial opportunity for everyone involved. Embark on a journey towards a healthier and wealthier future with us!
term_and_condition:
The following terms and conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program as both a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and as an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to purchase our products or services.

By participating in the Program, you agree to the terms outlined below. If you do not agree to these terms in full, you are not authorized to register or participate in the Program.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration
We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse in the event your application is rejected.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon Usage
Your affiliate link will be generated automatically upon approval. You may also create links to specific products or collections.

If a customer clicks on another affiliate's link and later clicks yours, the most recent valid click takes precedence.

You may be assigned a custom coupon code, which will be visible in your dashboard. If a customer uses both a link and a code, you will only receive one commission—never double. If you haven't been assigned a branded coupon, promotion of coupon codes is not permitted.

You are allowed to promote your affiliate link through online channels (e.g., social media) and offline methods (e.g., printed publications), as long as you comply with local laws and platform policies.

3. Commission & Payment Terms
You will earn a 20% commission on the value of every eligible order referred through your affiliate link or code, excluding taxes, shipping, and additional fees.

In order to receive payment, you must input valid payment details in the Settings section of your dashboard. Payments are processed according to the schedule noted in the Affiliate Guide.

Important:

  • Commissions are only paid on completed, non-refunded orders.

  • If an order is refunded or charged back during our standard return period, the commission will not be paid.

  • This ensures fairness and aligns commission payouts with successful, retained transactions.

Commission status is visible under the "Commission" tab, and any processed payments will appear under "Payment".

4. Marketing Tools
Approved marketing materials—such as banners, logos, and promotional content—are available under the Marketing Tool tab. You may download or embed these assets as needed to support your promotional efforts.

5. Network Referrals (if enabled)
If the Network feature is activated, you may invite other affiliates to join as part of your team. When one of your downline affiliates makes a sale, you may also receive a network commission, depending on our current settings.

To invite others, share your referral link from the Network tab. Any sign-up through your link will be tracked as your downline.

6. Cookie Tracking
We use cookies to track affiliate referrals. This means the user must have cookies enabled in their browser for tracking to work.

If a user clears or blocks cookies, we cannot guarantee tracking or commission attribution.

The cookie tracking duration is stated during affiliate registration. Any orders placed within this timeframe after clicking your link (or using your code) will automatically qualify for commission.

7. Removal from the Program
If you wish to leave the affiliate program, simply email us at andre@nuvibody.com, and we’ll process your removal.
